concerns.text: T003 writes engineered.csv 'without extra columns' and moves electronegativity_diff/valence_electron_diff to a separate engineered_extra.csv, but dataset.schema.yaml REQUIRES both fields in the curated dataset (required list) and T007 trains Linear Regression on all three feature columns from the engineered data. An implementer cannot deterministically execute T003/T007: either engineered.csv conforms to the schema (all three features) or the split stands and T007's input is undefined. Reconcile the file layout, the schema, and T007's stated input.

Plan and data-model designate data/curated/filtered.csv as the Single Source of Truth (Constitution Principle IV) and FR-008 names it as baseline.py's input, but no task produces filtered.csv; the pipeline instead emits curated_clean.csv → engineered.csv → baseline_shifted.csv. Tasks are internally executable but contradict the plan/data-model/FR-008 input path — either add a task producing filtered.csv (or rename the final artifact and update plan/data-model/FR-008 references) so the implementer knows which file is authoritative.

T007 specifies '≥1000 resamples' while the data model mandates 10,000 resamples with a percentile-inversion p-value procedure. The implementer gets two different numbers and no p-value procedure. Pick one (10,000, percentile-inversion) and state it in T007.

concerns.text: Plan assigns FR-005/FR-009 to code/validation/sensitivity_analysis.py; T008 builds code/validation/stability_index_report.py. Filename mismatch makes plan-traced execution ambiguous — align the script name across plan and task.

T011's verification is 'a lint script checks that each number is sourced from a JSON/CSV artifact' — no script path, no name, no acceptance rule (what counts as 'sourced'?). Not executable as written; name the script (e.g. code/validation/check_report_sources.py) and its pass criterion.

T012 requires raw dataset size ≤10 MB 'checked via data/logs/dataset_size.log', but no task creates dataset_size.log or the measurement that writes it. Add the producer (e.g. in T001/T013) or specify where the log is generated, otherwise the final integration test parses a file nothing writes.

T009's verification says 'existence and schema compliance of the report' but no schema for validation/validation_report.json is named (validation_report.schema.yaml is the stability-index report schema and lacks significance_verified/model_comparison fields). Name the schema or specify the field-level checks the test performs.

T006 asks the unit test to 'assert [training CPU time] ≤15 minutes on a 2-core runner' — a wall/CPU-time assertion inside pytest is environment-dependent and flaky. Prefer asserting the logged value in training_time_rf.log against the budget in the integration test (T012 already does this).
